title: Czech Government Scholarships for Developing Countries
provider: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MSMT), Czech Republic
field: All fields (Czech-taught programmes, including a one-year Czech language course)
description: Full scholarships for citizens of selected developing countries to pursue bachelor's, master's or doctoral study at Czech public universities, taught in Czech and preceded by a preparatory language year.
amount: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, and support towards accommodation and living costs

title: Visegrad Scholarship Programme
description: Scholarships for master's and doctoral study or research at accredited universities in the Visegrad Four countries (including Czechia) for citizens of the V4, the Eastern Partnership and the Western Balkans.
amount: EUR 2,500 per semester for the scholar plus a contribution to the host university

title: Charles University Scholarships for International Students
description: Institutional scholarships, rector's awards and tuition reductions for talented international students at Charles University in Prague, the Czech Republic's oldest and largest university.
amount: Partial to full tuition support and, for some awards, a one-off merit grant

title: Brno Ph.D. Talent Scholarship
provider: Brno Ph.D. Talent (JCMM, South Moravian Centre for International Mobility)
description: Top-up scholarship for first-year doctoral candidates at Brno universities in technical and natural science fields, awarded by open competition to Czech and international students.
amount: CZK 330,000 over three years in addition to the standard doctoral stipend

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Czechia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Czech institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
